subtitle: At the frontier of Devagiri’s power, a grandson carves a house for numbers into stone

panels.shot: low-angle wide of an old stone slab half-buried in scrub, with faint Nagari letters, under a vast Deccan sky
panels.action: Changadeva of Vijjalavida stands beside an ancient-looking stone inscription, hand resting on it, gazing toward a hazy outline of Devagiri’s hill-fort in the distance, as young pupils sit with palm-leaf manuscripts at his feet.

dialogue.text: In the shadow of Devagiri, Bhaskara II’s grandson, Changadeva of Vijjalavida, carved a school of numbers into stone while empires shifted around him.

i18n.hi: देवगिरि की छाया में, भास्कर द्वितीय का पोता, विज्जलाविदा का चंगदेव, बदलते साम्राज्यों के बीच पत्थर में अंकों की पाठशाला तराश रहा था।

panels.shot: epic bird’s-eye over the Deccan plateau, with Devagiri fort in mid-distance and a small riverside settlement in the foreground
panels.action: A sweeping view shows the rocky hill of Devagiri crowned with fortifications, beyond fields and a modest riverside village where a simple shrine and a cluster of tiled-roof houses hug a dusty path.

dialogue.text: Around 1207, the Yadavas ruled from rising Devagiri, yet far from the court a quieter work unfolded in the scrublands of Khandesh, in a place scholars call Vijjalavida.

i18n.hi: लगभग १२०७ में, यादव rising देवगिरि से राज करते थे, पर दरबार से दूर, खंडेश की झाड़ियाँ में विज्जलाविदा नाम की जगह पर चुपचाप एक काम चल रहा था।

panels.shot: slow push-in on an elderly Bhaskara II teaching under a tree, with a boy Changadeva watching
panels.action: Bhaskara II, white-bearded and calm, sits cross-legged under a broad tree, a palm-leaf manuscript on his lap, while a younger boy—Changadeva—peers from behind a pillar, eyes wide as students recite.

dialogue.text: Bhaskara, born in Vijjalavida, had written the Siddhanta Shiromani and Karana-kutuhala, works of sky and number; his family absorbed this learning like breath.

i18n.hi: विज्जलाविदा में जन्मे भास्कर ने ‘सिद्धांत शिरोमणि’ और ‘करण-कुतूहल’ लिखे—आकाश और अंकों के ग्रंथ; उनका घर इस ज्ञान को सांस की तरह पीता था।

panels.shot: close-up on Bhaskara II’s hand writing on a palm leaf, faint stars sketched beside numbers
panels.action: A weathered hand incises neat Nagari numbers on a palm leaf, a simple stylised diagram of the ecliptic and a small circle marking the sun, an oil lamp casting warm light on the script.

dialogue.text: In these leaves he set rules for eclipses and planetary paths, methods for algebra and arithmetic, verses that married verse and calculation in one breath.

i18n.hi: इन पन्नों में उसने ग्रहणों और ग्रह-पथों के नियम, बीजगणित और अंकगणित की विधियाँ, और ऐसे श्लोक रखे जो कविता और गणना को एक ही सांस में जोड़ देते थे।

panels.shot: medium shot of now-grown Changadeva in a modest house, holding an old manuscript with reverence
panels.action: An adult Changadeva kneels in a small, shadowed room, holding a brittle palm-leaf manuscript wrapped in cloth, his face a mix of grief and resolve, a simple altar with a brass lamp behind him.

dialogue.text: By Changadeva’s time, his grandfather was gone, but the manuscripts remained—fragile, hand-copied threads linking their house to centuries of Indian astronomy and mathematics.

i18n.hi: चंगदेव के समय तक दादा चले गए थे, पर हस्तलिखित पांडुलिपियाँ बचीं—नाज़ुक धागे, जो उनके घर को भारतीय ज्योतिष और गणित की सदियों से जोड़ते थे।

panels.shot: over-the-shoulder of Changadeva reading by lamplight as rain lashes outside
panels.action: Seen from behind, Changadeva bends over a palm-leaf manuscript, lips moving as he reads a metrical rule, while outside the doorway monsoon rain slants across the yard.

dialogue.speaker: changadeva_and_bhaskara_ii
dialogue.text: If these verses stay only in this house, they will die with me.

i18n.hi: अगर ये श्लोक सिर्फ इस घर में रह गए, तो वे मेरे साथ ही मर जाएँगे।

panels.shot: wide shot of a small assembly of villagers and students before a shrine, with Changadeva addressing them
panels.action: In front of a modest shrine under a tree, Changadeva stands on a low stone, speaking to a mixed group of young students and older householders, some holding palm leaves, a cow grazing nearby.

dialogue.text: The Changadeva inscription tells us he did more than memorize; he gathered land, people and purpose to make a place where Bhaskara’s works would be studied.

i18n.hi: चंगदेव का शिलालेख दिखाता है कि उसने सिर्फ याद नहीं किया; ज़मीन, लोग और मकसद जुटाकर ऐसी जगह बनाई जहाँ भास्कर के ग्रंथ पढ़े जाएँ।

panels.shot: medium shot of a scribe chiseling letters into a stone slab while Changadeva dictates
panels.action: A stonecutter kneels by a rectangular slab, chisel poised, as Changadeva stands beside him, right hand raised as if reciting, while faint incised Nagari lines already mark the surface.

dialogue.text: His charter, carved in stone, records a gift: land set aside so that students might live and learn, studying the Siddhanta Shiromani and Karana-kutuhala in this frontier village.

i18n.hi: उसका पत्थर पर खुदा फरमान एक दान बताता है: ज़मीन छोड़ी गई ताकि विद्यार्थी यहाँ रहें, सीखें, और सीमा के इस गाँव में सिद्धांत शिरोमणि और करण-कुतूहल पढ़ें।

panels.shot: close-up on the carved inscription lines, with key words subtly emphasized by light
panels.action: The camera lingers on crisp, freshly carved Nagari letters across the stone surface, the light catching a line that names Changadeva and another that refers to Bhaskara’s treatises.

dialogue.text: Modern scholars reading this stone hear a clear voice: a grandson naming his lineage, naming Bhaskara’s texts, and tying their study to this soil.

i18n.hi: आज के विद्वान इस पत्थर को पढ़ते हैं तो एक साफ आवाज़ सुनते हैं—एक पोता, अपनी वंशावली, भास्कर के ग्रंथों के नाम, और उनकी पढ़ाई को इस मिट्टी से जोड़ता हुआ।

panels.shot: interior wide of the new math school—a simple hall with students and diagrams
panels.action: Inside a long, simple hall open to a courtyard, bare-backed students sit in rows on mats, one drawing a circle and chord on a wooden board while Changadeva stands at the front, pointing toward a hanging board with a hand-drawn armillary-like sketch.

dialogue.text: This was no royal academy; the inscription names no king as founder. It shows a more common story—local initiative, family tradition, and quiet institutional work at the edge of empire.

i18n.hi: ये कोई शाही अकादमी नहीं थी; शिलालेख में किसी राजा का नाम संस्थापक के रूप में नहीं है। ये एक आम कहानी दिखाता है—स्थानीय पहल, पारिवारिक परंपरा और सीमा पर चलती शांत संस्थागत मेहनत।

panels.shot: medium shot of Changadeva teaching a verse, students chanting in unison
panels.action: Changadeva raises one finger as he recites, while a line of boys and young men repeat, eyes closed, their hands counting beats on their knees, an open manuscript in front of one.

dialogue.text: Verses on sines, eclipses and arithmetic were chanted aloud. Memory carried the rules, while the school’s manuscripts carried their exact words into another generation.

i18n.hi: ज्या, ग्रहण और अंकगणित के श्लोक ज़ोर से गाए जाते थे। नियम याददाश्त में रहते, और स्कूल की पांडुलिपियाँ उन्हीं शब्दों को अगली पीढ़ी तक पहुँचातीं।

panels.shot: close-up on a young student’s face lit by lamplight, reflected in his eye are star positions on a board
panels.action: A young student leans close to a wooden board marked with concentric circles and dots for planets, the lamplight reflecting both the diagram and a faint starry sky through the window in his wide eye.

dialogue.speaker: changadeva_and_bhaskara_ii
dialogue.text: Remember: the verse is the key, the computation is the door it opens.

i18n.hi: याद रखो: श्लोक चाबी है, गणना वो दरवाज़ा है जो वह खोलती है।

panels.shot: wide shot showing Devagiri fort in the distance as a caravan passes by the village school
panels.action: A caravan of ox-carts and riders rumbles along a dusty road, Devagiri’s silhouette on the horizon, while the village school sits to one side, its courtyard filled with students under the trees.

dialogue.text: While Yadava power swelled and roads filled with caravans and soldiers, this small school quietly bound Vijjalavida’s past to Devagiri’s rising present through shared calculation.

i18n.hi: जब यादव शक्ति फूल रही थी और रास्ते काफिलों और सैनिकों से भर रहे थे, यह छोटा स्कूल शांत गणनाओं से विज्जलाविदा के अतीत को देवगिरि के उभरते वर्तमान से बाँध रहा था।

panels.shot: medium shot of Changadeva and a visiting scholar exchanging manuscripts
panels.action: Changadeva clasps the arm of a visiting scholar in travel-stained robes as they exchange bundles of palm-leaf manuscripts in a shaded verandah, students watching intently from behind.

dialogue.text: Texts did not stay still. Carried by scholars and students, copies of Bhaskara’s treatises travelled between such schools, weaving a network far beyond any single court.

i18n.hi: ग्रंथ भी स्थिर नहीं थे। विद्वानों और विद्यार्थियों के कंधों पर भास्कर के treatise की प्रतियाँ ऐसे स्कूलों के बीच घूमतीं, अदालतों से कहीं दूर तक जाल बुनतीं।

panels.shot: documentary-style map overlay showing Maharashtra and Khandesh with a question mark at Vijjalavida
panels.action: A parchment-like map of western India fills the frame, with the region of Maharashtra and Khandesh shaded; a tiny hill-icon marks Devagiri and a faint question-mark hovers near a labeled but slightly blurred Vijjalavida.

dialogue.text: Today we cannot place Vijjalavida with certainty; scholars debate its exact spot, though most see it in this Maharashtra–Khandesh belt, near the Yadava heartland.

i18n.hi: आज हम विज्जलाविदा को बिल्कुल नाप नहीं सकते; विद्वान उसकी सही जगह पर बहस करते हैं, पर ज़्यादातर उसे महाराष्ट्र–खंडेश की इसी पट्टी में, यादवों के दिल के पास रखते हैं।

panels.shot: split-panel feel: on one side, Changadeva teaching; on the other, a modern scholar reading the inscription
panels.action: On the left, Changadeva gestures to a diagram in the school hall; on the right, centuries later, a modern epigrapher kneels beside the weathered inscription in the field, tracing the same carved letters with careful fingers.

dialogue.text: Yet the inscription’s words are clear enough to bridge eight centuries, aligning the voices of Bhaskara’s house with those who read his verses today.

i18n.hi: फिर भी शिलालेख के शब्द इतने साफ हैं कि आठ सदियों को जोड़ दें—भास्कर के घर की आवाज़ें आज उनके श्लोक पढ़ने वालों से मिल जाती हैं।

panels.shot: close-up on the weathered inscription now, with lichen on the stone and faint letters
panels.action: The camera lingers on the same stone slab, now cracked and mottled with lichen, its letters softened but still legible in the slanting light of late afternoon.

dialogue.text: Kim Plofker and David Pingree read in this stone not a legend, but firm evidence of how Bhaskara’s works were kept alive in Yadava-country institutions.

i18n.hi: किम प्लोफ़कर और डेविड पिंग्री को इस पत्थर में कहानी नहीं, ठोस सबूत दिखते हैं कि यादव-देश की संस्थाओं में भास्कर के ग्रंथ कैसे ज़िंदा रखे गए।

panels.shot: slow pull-back from the stone to reveal ruins of the school and distant modern fields
panels.action: The view pulls back from the inscription to show remnants of old foundations half-lost in grass, blending into present-day fields where farmers work under the same broad sky.

dialogue.text: The later Kerala school would craft new techniques elsewhere, but this stone belongs to another story—of a Deccan lineage building a school so that inherited knowledge could outlast its founders.

i18n.hi: बाद की केरल स्कूल ने कहीं और नई विधियाँ गढ़ीं, पर ये पत्थर दूसरी कहानी का है—दक्खन की एक वंश-परंपरा की, जिसने स्कूल खड़ा किया ताकि मिला हुआ ज्ञान संस्थापक के बाद भी जिए।

panels.shot: final contemplative wide shot of a modern classroom overlaid faintly with silhouettes of Changadeva’s school
panels.action: A contemporary classroom of students with notebooks and blackboard is shown, and faintly over it, like a ghostly double exposure, the outline of Changadeva’s open hall and palm-leaf manuscripts aligns with their desks.

dialogue.text: Changadeva’s inscription reminds us that ideas endure not only through genius, but through places built to teach them—houses of number at the edge of empire, and in every age after.

i18n.hi: चंगदेव का शिलालेख याद दिलाता है कि विचार सिर्फ प्रतिभा से नहीं, उनसे सीखने की जगहों से भी बचते हैं—सीमा पर बने अंकों के घरों से, और हर जमाने में।

title_i18n.en: The School of Numbers at the Edge of Empire
title_i18n.hi: सीमा पर बसे अंकों का पाठशाला

subtitle_i18n.en: At the frontier of Devagiri’s power, a grandson carves a house for numbers into stone
subtitle_i18n.hi: देवगिरि की हद पर, एक पोता पत्थर में अंकों का घर गढ़ रहा है
